_about: The four emails as the Funding Follow-up Dashboard wrote them before the templates (csm_workspace.js at main 490e11ad, seedMail), for Pasadena with the CPL Coordinator Ana Rivera on file. Key: template|deadline set|close title on the landing page|CO Monitor's note set. Value: subject, a line of three dashes, the message. Captured 2026-11-10 (S626b, COBIx on PR 3068) so tests/csm_workspace_templates.test.js can compare the shipped wording word for word.

cases.lead|true|false|false:
CPL Implementation Funding: the Noncredit CPL Lead role in MAP for Pasadena
---
Dear Ana Rivera,

The CPL Initiative team is writing about the noncredit share of CPL Implementation Funding for Pasadena. MAP does not yet show a Noncredit CPL Lead for Pasadena. The condition is met when the college's lead holds the Noncredit CPL Lead role in MAP, under that exact title. A Noncredit CPL Lead attestation on the CPL Implementation Funding page is accepted as well.

The CPL Implementation Funding page explains the condition: https://cpl-initiative.github.io/cpl-project-tracker/funding-model/

If it is already on its way, or if someone else at Pasadena should receive this note, a short reply will let us update our records.

The CPL Initiative team
